title: Preparation of 5M NaOH Solution
author: Nicola O'Reilly
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfewjjfe

steps.title: Prepare NaOH Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 5M NaOH solution while working in a fume hood.

substeps.instruction: Weigh out 30 g of NaOH and add to a 500 mL beaker.
Measure out 250 mL of milliQ water and add to the beaker.

steps.title: Adjust Final Volume
steps.instruction: Ensure the solution reaches the correct final volume using a graduated cylinder.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the solution to a 500 ml graduated cylinder.
Make up to 300 ml using milliQ water, if necessary.

steps.title: Bottle and Label Solution
steps.instruction: Transfer the solution to a storage container and label it.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the solution to a 500 ml Duran bottle.
Label the bottle with the batch and date.

steps.title: Store Solution
steps.instruction: Store the solution at room temperature (15 °C – 25 °C).
